title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.10.0 adds six CPU teaching laboratories for Weeks 17-22: Q/K/V attention, next-character language modeling, tokenization and sensor design, missing-observation reconstruction, autonomous wake prediction and transfer/information-budget audits. The course includes 50 notebooks and 33 lecture PDFs. The six new weeks contain 24 coding exercises, executed student notebooks, separate instructor solutions, editable lectures, frozen prediction/checkpoint evidence and reproducibility checks. The homepage and weekly pages show native-grid velocity/vorticity contours, sensor locations and spatial errors with shared scales and recorded provenance. Previously inspected coarse LBM wakes are retained evaluation cases, not new blind tests; the character language model and continuous-state CFD decoder are separate experiments. Equal optimizer-update ceilings do not establish equal FLOPs or source information. Linux numerical tolerances and remaining interactive Colab and student workload/grading acceptance checks are documented. The earlier Week 16 SU2 8.0.1 educational core and its evidence remain available. NASA SEEB-ALR reproduction remains a failed, deferred research appendix; NASA CFD validation, full Beihang aircraft reproduction, atmospheric propagation and ground PLdB are not claimed. Data provenance, case-specific reuse limits and AI-assistance disclosure remain part of the repository.
